Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band supports join-code sessions, remote instrument and ARM controls, scheduled playback, relay diagnostics and all-Bard START confirmation and fail-safe cancellation.
Changelog: Hosted Band conductors can use //pm shortcuts to run a saved FFXIV macro slot on every connected bard who allows it. Individual and Shared slots work across parties and PCs.
